verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs show contact and company records, associations between companies and activities such as calls or meetings via import, and email replies logged to the CRM. That covers linked records and activity capture. No evidence shows a per-record activity timeline view on contacts and companies, and contact-company linking is shown only through import. Missing for 10: documented activity timeline on each contact/company record, explicit contact-to-company association management in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: You can import records such as companies or deals, as well as activities like calls or meetings, and create associations between them.
the contacts endpoints allow you to create and manage contact records in your HubSpot account
HubSpot automatically deduplicates contacts using email addresses, and companies using domain names.
log email replies to the CRM
